reasons: After the multicall batch, Size enforces a RELATIVE/CONDITIONAL check (validateBorrowATokenIncreaseLteDebtTokenDecrease): only if borrowAToken supply ends above the cap, the increase must be <= the debt-token decrease. During the batch the ABSOLUTE per-call cap check (validateBorrowATokenCap) is skipped. The two checks use different accounting bases, so it is NOT established that the final check fully covers the skipped cap — that is the open question for the sequence gate. No vulnerability is claimed at this stage.
unresolved_assumptions: borrowAToken.balanceOf(address(this)) tracks total protocol borrow supply for the cap intent.
No other post-batch guard re-imposes the absolute cap.
summary_plain_english: After the multicall batch, Size enforces a RELATIVE/CONDITIONAL check (validateBorrowATokenIncreaseLteDebtTokenDecrease): only if borrowAToken supply ends above the cap, the increase must be <= the debt-token decrease. During the batch the ABSOLUTE per-call cap check (validateBorrowATokenCap) is skipped. The two checks use different accounting bases, so it is NOT established that the final check fully covers the skipped cap — that is the open question for the sequence gate. No vulnerability is claimed at this stage.
invariant_claim: If the multicall batch leaves borrowAToken supply above borrowATokenCap, then (supplyAfter - supplyBefore) must be <= (debtSupplyBefore - debtSupplyAfter); otherwise the batch reverts. Below the cap, no constraint is imposed.
final_validation_plain_english: Only acts when borrowATokenSupplyAfter > borrowATokenCap; then requires the borrow increase to be no greater than the debt decrease, else reverts BORROW_ATOKEN_INCREASE_EXCEEDS_DEBT_TOKEN_DECREASE.

skipped_or_deferred_checks.name: validateBorrowATokenCap

coverage_analysis.skipped_basis: absolute cap on total borrowAToken supply
coverage_analysis.final_basis: relative increase vs debt decrease, only evaluated when supply is already above the cap
coverage_analysis.reasoning: The skipped check forbids supply > cap outright. The final check does NOT re-impose that absolute limit; it only requires that any above-cap increase be matched by a debt decrease. These are different accounting bases, so the final check does not obviously replace the per-call cap. Whether an interleaving can end above-cap without a matching debt decrease is UNDETERMINED here and needs sequence generation.

accounting_basis_analysis.final_check_basis: relative delta (increase vs debt decrease), conditional on above-cap

what_invariant_covers: The 'deposit-to-repay' flow: an above-cap supply increase matched by an equal-or-greater debt decrease.
what_invariant_may_not_cover: The absolute per-call cap that is skipped in multicall (different accounting basis).
Interleavings that end above the cap WITHOUT a matching debt decrease — undetermined here.
candidate_risk_statement: HYPOTHESIS (unconfirmed; not a vulnerability claim): because the per-call absolute cap is deferred in multicall and the final check is relative/conditional, an attacker-controlled batch MIGHT leave the protocol above the borrowAToken cap without a matching debt decrease. A concrete exploit sequence is required to confirm or refute this, and the behavior may be fully covered or intended.
exploit_sequence_prerequisites: A callable sub-call that increases borrowAToken supply without a matching debt decrease.
Ability to keep the batch's final (increase vs debt-decrease) relation satisfied or below-cap.
blockers_before_sequence_generation: Need to enumerate which sub-calls move borrowAToken up vs debtToken down (sequence_gate).
Need to confirm the final check cannot be satisfied trivially while leaving an invalid state.
invariant_statement: If multicall leaves borrowAToken supply above the cap, the supply increase must be <= the debt-token decrease; below the cap, unconstrained.
covers: above-cap increase matched by debt decrease (deposit-to-repay)
may_not_cover: the skipped absolute per-call cap (validateBorrowATokenCap), different accounting basis
